version_file.description: Path to version file (relative to repo root)

agents.description: List of agents to sync ATDD rules to

skip_workflows.description: Skip generating CI workflow files during atdd init. Use for repos that maintain their own workflows (e.g., the atdd toolkit itself).

code.description: Implementation-root map consumed by hierarchy coverage resolvers. Keys are stack names (python, supabase, web, toolkit, plus consumer-defined), values are paths relative to the repo root. See src/atdd/coach/conventions/code-roots.convention.yaml.

additionalProperties.description: Path to implementation root (relative to repo root)

stack_containers.description: Stack-container map: the project directory per stack, holding stack-level manifests (package.json, tsconfig.json) and sibling trees (tests/, migrations/). Distinct from `code`, the source root: web code lives in web/src but tsconfig.json sits in web/. Keys are stack names, values are paths relative to the repo root. Consumed via atdd.coach.utils.config.resolve_stack_container.

additionalProperties.description: Path to the stack's project container (relative to repo root)

stack_entrypoints.description: Stack-entrypoint map: the 'root app' per stack, relative to that stack's code root. Defaults to app.py for python (the station master). A consumer whose backend entrypoint is main.py declares it here instead of forking a validator. Consumed via atdd.coach.utils.config.resolve_stack_entrypoint.

additionalProperties.description: Entrypoint file relative to the stack's code root

coverage.description: Hierarchy coverage validation settings (ATDD Hierarchy Coverage Spec v0.1)

wagons_not_in_train.description: Wagon slugs allowed without train coverage

features_orphaned.description: Feature URNs allowed without wagon manifest reference

wmbts_without_acceptance.description: WMBT URNs allowed without acceptance criteria

acceptance_without_tests.description: Acceptance URNs allowed without test coverage

features_without_implementation.description: Feature URNs allowed without code implementation

min_acceptance_coverage.description: Minimum percentage of acceptances that must have tests

localization.description: Localization validation settings (Localization Manifest Spec v1)

manifest.description: Path to localization manifest.json relative to repo root (e.g., web/locales/manifest.json)

github.description: GitHub integration settings for issue-based session tracking

project_number.description: GitHub Projects v2 number (visible in URL)

project_id.description: GitHub Projects v2 node ID (GraphQL identifier)

field_schema.description: Reference to the custom field schema definition

themes.description: Optional digit (0-9) → custom theme-name mapping merged with the 10 built-in defaults. Values are resolved at runtime via `get_theme_map(config)` (atdd.coach.utils.theme_map). Overriding digit 0 emits warning W-THEME-001 (non-blocking).

path_filters.description: Custom path → phase mappings for path-scoped validation

train_renders_content.description: Behavioral train-render validator settings (#335). When enabled, src/atdd/tester/validators/test_train_renders_content.py mounts every train via .atdd/harness/mount-train.mjs and asserts the rendered DOM is non-empty and non-stub.

enabled.description: Opt-in flag. Default false so toolkit-self and BE-only repos skip the check.

harness_timeout_seconds.description: Per-train mount timeout passed to HarnessInvoker.

repo.description: Consumer-repo substrate settings (issue #415, spec v12 §9.3). Written by `atdd init --consumer-repo` (or by default heuristic when `plan/` exists and `src/atdd/` does not). The `--toolkit` flag removes this block.

test_root.description: Path the substrate pytest plugin walks for `# Acceptance:` headers (consumed by `atdd.tester.substrate.plugin`, issue #411). Relative to repo root.

plan_root.description: Walker root for AcceptanceResolver (issue #408). Relative to repo root.

substrate.description: Substrate registration metadata. Pinned schema so the plugin (#411) reads what `atdd init` (#415) writes.

enabled.description: Toggle for opting out without running `atdd init --toolkit`. The substrate pytest plugin checks this before scanning for anchored tests.

plugin.description: Entry-point id of the substrate pytest plugin. Mirrors `[project.entry-points.pytest11]` in the toolkit pyproject.toml.

mode.description: Mode resolved by `atdd init`. Subsequent bare `atdd init` reads this and stays in mode (override needs explicit --toolkit / --consumer-repo).

session_gate_command_prefixes.description: Allowed prefixes for gate commands in session files

session_gate_command_exceptions.description: Session files exempt from gate command prefix validation (by filename pattern)

archive_status_warnings.description: Warn when COMPLETE sessions not in archive or archived sessions not COMPLETE
